*** HEADLINE: COPILOT STUDIO WHAT'S-NEW UNFROZE. It sat at the July 2026 edition for ~12
    weeks and the last 4 scans recorded it as a dead feed. It now carries ms.date
    2026-10-05 / updated_at 2026-10-06 and a full SEPTEMBER 2026 section. Four new
    surfaces had accumulated unseen. LESSON: a frozen Microsoft feed is frozen until it
    isn't — keep fetching dead feeds, and when one moves, read the newest section by
    OPENING EVERY LINKED ARTICLE. Every one of the four findings needed the article; the
    roll-up line alone carried none of the security-relevant detail. ***

=== MICROSOFT COPILOT STUDIO === (4 findings — all reported 2026-10-06)
whats-new ms.date 2026-10-05, updated_at 2026-10-06. September 2026 section literal list:
  extract node; Copilot node (preview); model dropdown for GitHub Copilot harness agents;
  content safety test method; attach files GA (Excel/PPT/Word); Dataverse tables knowledge.
REPORTED:
  * Copilot node (doc ms.date 09-15). Runs Copilot Chat OR a COWORK TASK. Runs as the
    connected M365 user — "whatever that user can see in M365, the workflow can use."
    Agent dropdown: Researcher, Analyst, tenant Agent Builder agents. Cowork can START a
    new task or RESUME AN EXISTING TASK (inject instructions into in-flight work).
  * Dataverse tables as knowledge (doc ms.date 09-25). <=15 tables/source. PREVIEW extends
    retrieval into MemoType (Multiline Text) and FileType (File) columns. ENABLING ACT IS
    IN POWER APPS, NOT COPILOT STUDIO: mark column Searchable + add to Quick Find View.
    Up to 2 days backfill. Requires auth mode "Authenticate with Microsoft".
  * extract node (doc ms.date 09-10). PDF/Word/Excel/PPT -> named values + tables.
    Maker-selectable extraction model. Input usually a mailbox attachment or SharePoint.
  * content safety test method. Severity threshold 0-7 per content type (0 strictest,
    7 most permissive). 4 types: hate/unfairness, sexual, violence, self-harm.
NOT REPORTED (model/version): harness model dropdown w/ experimental models; attach-files
  GA expansion.
NEXT: the September list is now mined. Watch for an OCTOBER section.

=== OPENAI === (3 findings)
developers.openai.com/api/docs/changelog literal list: 10-05 HIPAA BAA in-product flow;
  09-29 computer use in Agents API + GPT-6.1 Sol (multi-agent beta) + Ultrafast;
  09-25 image encoding fix; 09-22 GPT-6 Sol+Luna; 09-15 API key creation governance;
  09-10 project key expiration + Agents API public beta + GPT-Live 1 GA; 09-08 prompt
  cache diagnostics GA + GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst/Flare + GPT-Rosalind GA; 09-03 GPT-6
  Astra + async tool calling + mid-turn steering; 09-02 error taxonomy; 09-01 IPv6.
learn.chatgpt.com/docs/changelog literal list: 10-05 Codex CLI 0.160.1; 10-02 iOS
  1.2026.267; 10-01 Codex CLI 0.160.0; 09-30 0.159.3; 09-29 GPT-6.1 Sol; 09-29 0.159.2 /
  0.159.1 / 0.159.0; 09-28 0.158.0.
REPORTED:
  * CODEX GUARDIAN / AUTO-REVIEW. approvals_reviewer = "guardian_subagent". Reviewer
    subagent REPLACES HUMAN APPROVAL at the sandbox boundary for shell, file writes,
    network, MCP tool calls. 0.160.0 added two OPT-IN (default-off) capabilities: retrieve
    earlier user instructions; include agent-handoff context. Policy customizable per
    enterprise (guardian_policy_config) and per user ([auto_review].policy). KNOWN UPSTREAM
    ISSUES: auto_review.policy SILENTLY REPLACES the catalog security policy (#38316);
    auto_review.extra_policy SILENTLY OMITTED under current catalog template (#50309).
    => effective policy != configured policy.
    Docs: learn.chatgpt.com/docs/sandboxing/auto-review
  * Codex 0.158.0 MCP auth: OAuth client secrets + WebSocket bearer tokens. 0.160.1 fixed
    Windows env-var preservation for remote MCP servers.
  * API key governance (09-15) + max key lifetime (09-10). Org overrides project.
    EXISTING KEYS UNAFFECTED — a restriction can be on while legacy long-lived keys live.
NOT REPORTED: 10-05 HIPAA BAA flow (compliance workflow, not a surface).
UNMINED NEXT: Agents API reference path still unknown (old URL 404s). Codex Cloud still
  unexamined. learn.chatgpt.com/docs/whats-new weekly roll-ups still unwatched.

  09-02, 09-01.
REPORTED:

    SQL, Spanner. QUERIES IN PLACE over MCP with EACH USER'S OWN credentials (IAM or
    OAuth 2.1). NO DATA STORE ARTIFACT EXISTS — ingestion-based inventory goes blind.
    Attaching a connector in this mode AUTO-ENABLES Knowledge Catalog on the Assistant tab.
    doc: /gemini/enterprise/docs/connectors/connect-data-cloud
